title: Not burlap, but are well made
text: Not burlap, but are well made. These are pretty thick, but are NOT burlap material. They are more of an identifiable weave of brown and white, and overall didnt give the "burlap" look i was going for, so i returned them. They are quite heavy and thicker than expected, as well. Well made, however.
